purpose: Compact AI planning map for arena tests, auctions, prize-board contracts, food-row events, and cross-world economy pressure.

summaryTiers.always: Bazaar is an optional bright economy hub where rewards become renown, debt, rules, and future obligations.
summaryTiers.previousArcCarryForward: Do not let Bazaar solve core world plots outright. It converts progress into options and costs.
summaryTiers.avoidReadingFullArcUnless: Open activity files for exact arena, auction, food, or prize-board ops.

stats: C for bargain timing, public performance, and social checks

arcs.title: Central Ring First Visit
arcs.previousArcCarryover: Haven, Earth, and Zombie progress can become showcase lots, medical lots, and prize-board contracts, but every convenience creates a cost.
arcs.arcSummary: Introduce Bazaar rules, arena registration, small auctions, food-row relief, and prize-board cross-world summaries.
arcs.currentDevelopmentTarget: Make Bazaar events useful but never plot-solving. Use debt and renown as soft long-term consequence gates.

potentialChoicePoints.futureUse: Sponsor route opens discounts and obligations; independent route keeps freedom but costs more.
Riskier lots can help other worlds while increasing debt or unwanted attention.

eventSuitability.summary: Safe exhibitions, sponsor comments, audience jokes, and performance-based renown.
Medical lots, mystery lots, and debt notes with clear future obligations.

questSuitability.summary: Contracts should point back to active world arcs instead of replacing them.
Auction rewards can support Earth or Zombie while leaving a debt trail.

futureEditSlots: Record new debts, sponsors, and prize-board promises after each generated Bazaar event.
Add cross-world unlock notes only when the source world has earned them.
